_provenance: Design directive 2026-07-13 Part B: one continuous PIE session proving the core survival loop -- possess -> walk metal/rock/sand -> sprint (O2 drains faster) -> bend to read the gauge -> O2 falls to the low-O2 alarm -> return to the habitat -> O2 refills. Run ONLY through core.witness_runner (bounded wall-clock budget + guaranteed stop_pie/editor cleanup on exit -- see docs/MCP_PATHWAYS.md #33), never bare core.sleepwalker, for a session expected to run unattended. The O2-depletion and refill legs use the suit's own AdvanceLifeSupport(seconds) debug hook (advance_suit_seconds action, core/sleepwalker.py) to compress game-time rather than waiting out the real ~5-6 minute drain/regen curves live -- this is the SAME mechanism the design directive itself names ('drive the O2 clock fast rather than sitting through 6 real minutes'), used honestly and only for the depletion/refill legs; the walk/sprint/bend legs are real WASD-driven PIE input, read back live. reset_position anchor:'habitat' resolves against the pawn's actual spawn location captured at session start (see Sleepwalker.run's spawn_location/habitat_estimate), matching ADemoPlayerController::SpawnDemoHabitatIfNeeded's own placement formula (habitat = spawn - Forward*500) -- no hardcoded world coordinate assumed for the habitat.

beats.name: sprint_leg
beats._note: TWICE-REVISED 2026-07-13 (simtest evidence from two prior runs). (1) pawn_velocity_magnitude read rt.pawn.transform.velocity, which this bridge's runtime_report never populates (velocity_mag=0.00 even mid-sprint) -- avoided, proven displacement used instead. (2) The first displacement attempt reset to x=6000, which the o2witness_sprint/bend/low_o2_alarm screenshots then showed WAS PAST THE EDGE OF THE LEVEL'S SOLID GROUND (the pawn visibly falling through open sky, motion-blurred, no terrain visible) -- confounding the speed reading with un-decelerated momentum carryover (reset_position teleports location only, never velocity) instead of a clean sprint-vs-walk comparison. Rock's own walk beat (reset 2000 -> reached 3112) already proves solid ground through at least x=3112, so this resets to x=0 (metal pad, confirmed solid via o2witness_metal_walk) with a settle wait first (friction zeroes any residual velocity on real ground, unlike open air) for a clean from-rest sprint start, well inside the confirmed-solid corridor either way.

beats.name: bend_to_read_gauge
beats._note: pawn_property_toggles is the REVERSIBLE hard-fact crouch check (CapsuleHalfHeight 90->40->90) already proven in verb_interactions.beats.json; the explicit key_down/screenshot/key_up sequence additionally captures the diegetic HUD while actually bent, mode=full_editor_window because editor_viewport/game_viewport never composite Slate/UMG (docs/MCP_PATHWAYS.md #32).

beats.name: o2_drains_to_alarm
beats._note: REVISED 2026-07-13 (simtest evidence): the original AdvanceLifeSupport()-via-execute_python call silently did nothing (O2 barely moved from the real preceding beats' own natural drain) -- unreal.EditorLevelLibrary.get_all_level_actors() resolves the EDITOR world, not the live PIE world, so it never found the runtime-attached component. advance_suit_seconds now computes the SAME per-game-minute drain math core-side and writes the result through the proven set_component_property pathway (verified working all session), reading the current value first via the equally-proven get_component_property. min_floor=10 (rather than the component's own 0 floor) means this compresses ~15 simulated Idle-rate minutes into a value that reliably lands at 10 regardless of exactly what real-time drain the preceding beats left O2 at (any realistic starting point 100->80 clamps to the same floor) -- low-O2 alarm territory, deliberately short of the bDead edge this beat isn't meant to demonstrate.

beats.name: o2_refills_at_habitat
beats._note: Same core-side compression as o2_drains_to_alarm, net rate this time (garden regen 30/min minus idle drain 6/min = +24/min): from the floor of 10, 150s of simulated net regen lands at 70 -- comfortably clears the >40 recovery bar without depending on exactly what the prior beat left O2 at.
